top_signals.title: China 2027 Growth to Top 4.5%, Ex-Official Says
top_signals.summary: China’s economy is on track to grow more than 4.5% in 2027, according to former Vice Finance Minister Zhu Guangyao. Speaking to Bloomberg TV’s Avril Hong in Singapore on Wednesday, Zhu noted that Beijing still has room to loosen fiscal policy next year, while also stressing the need for AI regulation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Africa Eyeing SMRs to Supply 5.2 GW of Nuclear Capacity
top_signals.summary: South Africa is moving forward on plans to install 5.2 gigawatts of nuclear capacity, adding to its two nuclear reactors at Koeberg with a capacity of 1.85 GW. The units, which entered commercial service in 1984 and 1985 respectively, generate about 5% of the country’s electricity. Coal-fired power stations, mostly concentrated near coalfields in Mpumalanga, supply roughly three-quarters of South Africa’s power.
